text:
nora: Quick alert: onboarding run for rnrk-v3-int8 shows MRR regression focused on docs with bullet lists and inline code blocks. Overall NDCG ~neutral but top-1 is suffering.
ash: Any repro examples?
nora: Sample from holdout: query 'curl upload file s3 lambda'
doc1 (gold): 'Steps:\n- Create presigned URL\n- curl -X PUT -T file.json \`$URL\`\n- Trigger lambda via SNS' -> ranked 1 in fp16
doc2 (ptq): 'You can PUT the file using curl. Make sure to sign requests. See example:\n```\ncurl -X PUT -T file.json "$URL"\n```' -> falls to rank 3 under int8
ken: Interesting — lists + fenced code are common in docs. Tokenization around backticks or triple backticks could be collapsing tokens after PTQ conversion?
priya: We also saw similar deltas when onboarding small reranker variants. Could be attention bias towards punctuation tokens being quantized poorly.
eval-bot: queued eval job 5150000000: ./eval --model rnrk-v3-int8 --slice bullet_and_code --samples 2000 --save-artifacts
nora: I compared token counts: fp16 doc1 tokens 42, int8 doc1 tokens 40; fp16 doc2 tokens 57, int8 doc2 tokens 54. The relative shrinkage is larger near code fences.
ash: Can you show token strings near the fence?
nora: snippet fp16 tokens: ['```', 'curl', '-', 'X', 'PUT', '-T', 'file', '.', 'json', '"$URL"', '```']
int8 tokens: ['```curl', '-', 'XPUT', '-Tfile.json', '"$URL"```']
ken: Whoa — tokenizer merges ``` with following tokens in int8 pipeline. That indicates we might be using a different tokenizer binary at quantization time, or a different preproc flag.
priya: Which recipe was used for PTQ? per-tensor or per-channel? and was tokenizer exported with model artifacts?
nora: PTQ used per-tensor range calib. Tokenizer binary embedded during packaging but we did a separate fastmerge step that may have swapped tokenization config.
nash: Immediate mitigations: 1) add a whitespace-normalizer that ensures fenced blocks are separated by spaces before tokenization, 2) run per-channel calibration, 3) include tokenizer parity check in the model onboarding smoke tests.
ken: Also run a hybrid run where embedding/attn remain fp16 but MLP quantized, to isolate where scoring shifts occur.
eval-bot: :robot_face: job 5150000000-step1: ./eval --model rnrk-v3-int8 --slice bullet_and_code --preproc normalize_fenced --samples 1000 queued
eval-bot: :robot_face: job 5150000000-step2: ./eval --model rnrk-v3-hybrid --slice bullet_and_code --samples 1000 queued
priya: Please curate a golden slice of 500 bullet+code docs for CI. We'll add an assert for top1 MRR change <= 1.5% compared to fp16 baseline.
nora: Creating dataset now and will open PR with metadata + small runner. Tagging @ken @priya for review.
nash: We should also add a tokenizer-diff unit under devex to catch merges like '```curl' earlier. Small script: md -> normalize fenced code -> tokenization diff -> break if mismatch.
ken: I'll add the per-channel calib PR and a quick plot of head-wise activation distributions for code-heavy docs. If head collapse shows up it's a strong signal for per-head calibration necessity.
priya: Good. Also add a short note to the onboarding doc: 'check code block / list formatting slices when quantizing'.
eval-bot: :white_check_mark: job 5150000000-step1 completed: ptq+normalize MRR delta -1.8% vs fp16. step2 (hybrid) completed: hybrid delta -0.9%
nora: So normalization helps but hybrid is closer. Still want to fix tokenizer merging too.
nash: Thanks folks. Once PRs land let's rerun full holdout. I'll update the model bringup checklist.
ken: Will send attention norm dumps and tokenizer diffs in the PR.
priya: Great. Keep the golden slice evolving if we find other formatting failure modes (tables, inline html).
nora: Closing thread after PRs merge and rerun. Thanks!
